examples.hanzi: 校长邀请家长来参观学校。
examples.pinyin: Xiàozhǎng yāoqǐng jiāzhǎng lái cānguān xuéxiào.
examples.english: The principal invited parents to visit the school.

examples.hanzi: 我们校长每天早上都站在门口迎接学生。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen xiàozhǎng měi tiān zǎoshang dōu zhàn zài ménkǒu yíngjiē xuésheng.
examples.english: Our principal stands at the gate every morning to greet the students.

examples.hanzi: 加拿大的冬天很长，雪也很多。
examples.pinyin: Jiānádà de dōngtiān hěn cháng, xuě yě hěn duō.
examples.english: Winters in Canada are long and there is a lot of snow.

examples.hanzi: 他在加拿大住了五年，英语说得很好。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài Jiānádà zhù le wǔ nián, Yīngyǔ shuō de hěn hǎo.
examples.english: He lived in Canada for five years and speaks good English.

examples.hanzi: 开车时不要玩手机，驾驶要小心。
examples.pinyin: Kāi chē shí bú yào wán shǒujī, jiàshǐ yào xiǎoxīn.
examples.english: Don't play with your phone while driving; drive carefully.

examples.hanzi: 他有十年的驾驶经验。
examples.pinyin: Tā yǒu shí nián de jiàshǐ jīngyàn.
examples.english: He has ten years of driving experience.

examples.hanzi: 我们会全力支持你的决定。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen huì quánlì zhīchí nǐ de juédìng.
examples.english: We will fully support your decision.

examples.hanzi: 他全力跑向终点。
examples.pinyin: Tā quánlì pǎo xiàng zhōngdiǎn.
examples.english: He ran toward the finish line with all his strength.

examples.hanzi: 我的桌子一团糟，找不到东西了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ de zhuōzi yì tuán zāo, zhǎo bú dào dōngxi le.
examples.english: My desk is a complete mess and I can't find anything.

examples.hanzi: 会议开得一团糟，什么也没决定。
examples.pinyin: Huìyì kāi de yì tuán zāo, shénme yě méi juédìng.
examples.english: The meeting was a mess and nothing was decided.

examples.hanzi: 宇航员在太空里生活了半年。
examples.pinyin: Yǔhángyuán zài tàikōng lǐ shēnghuó le bàn nián.
examples.english: The astronaut lived in space for half a year.

examples.hanzi: 我想坐飞船去太空看看。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng zuò fēichuán qù tàikōng kànkan.
examples.english: I want to take a spaceship to see outer space.

examples.hanzi: 我昨天生病了，一直在家休息。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zuótiān shēngbìng le, yìzhí zài jiā xiūxi.
examples.english: I got sick yesterday and rested at home all day.

examples.hanzi: 天气变冷了，小心别生病。
examples.pinyin: Tiānqì biàn lěng le, xiǎoxīn bié shēngbìng.
examples.english: The weather has turned cold, so be careful not to get sick.

examples.hanzi: 刚搬到这里，我还不适应这里的天气。
examples.pinyin: Gāng bān dào zhèlǐ, wǒ hái bú shìyìng zhèlǐ de tiānqì.
examples.english: I just moved here and haven't gotten used to the weather yet.

examples.hanzi: 孩子很快就适应了新学校。
examples.pinyin: Háizi hěn kuài jiù shìyìng le xīn xuéxiào.
examples.english: The child quickly adapted to the new school.

examples.hanzi: 这么多工作，我一个人应付不过来。
examples.pinyin: Zhème duō gōngzuò, wǒ yí ge rén yìngfu bú guòlái.
examples.english: With this much work, I can't cope on my own.

examples.hanzi: 他随便说了几句话来应付客人。
examples.pinyin: Tā suíbiàn shuō le jǐ jù huà lái yìngfu kèrén.
examples.english: He said a few casual words to get through the guests.

examples.hanzi: 请保管好你的贵重物品。
examples.pinyin: Qǐng bǎoguǎn hǎo nǐ de guìzhòng wùpǐn.
examples.english: Please take good care of your valuables.

examples.hanzi: 这些物品都是免费提供的。
examples.pinyin: Zhèxiē wùpǐn dōu shì miǎnfèi tígōng de.
examples.english: All these items are provided free of charge.

examples.hanzi: 他看起来很凶，但不是坏人。
examples.pinyin: Tā kàn qǐlái hěn xiōng, dàn bú shì huàirén.
examples.english: He looks fierce, but he isn't a bad person.

examples.hanzi: 小朋友，不要跟陌生人走，他们可能是坏人。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎopéngyou, bú yào gēn mòshēngrén zǒu, tāmen kěnéng shì huàirén.
examples.english: Kids, don't go with strangers; they might be bad people.

examples.hanzi: 战争会毁灭一座城市。
examples.pinyin: Zhànzhēng huì huǐmiè yí zuò chéngshì.
examples.english: War can destroy a city.

examples.hanzi: 他的一次错误决定毁灭了整个公司。
examples.pinyin: Tā de yí cì cuòwù juédìng huǐmiè le zhěnggè gōngsī.
examples.english: One wrong decision of his ruined the whole company.

examples.hanzi: 那个人诅咒了我们，说我们不会成功。
examples.pinyin: Nàge rén zǔzhòu le wǒmen, shuō wǒmen bú huì chénggōng.
examples.english: That person cursed us, saying we would never succeed.

examples.hanzi: 童话里的巫婆诅咒了公主。
examples.pinyin: Tónghuà lǐ de wūpó zǔzhòu le gōngzhǔ.
examples.english: The witch in the fairy tale cursed the princess.

examples.hanzi: 他用坚定的眼神看着我。
examples.pinyin: Tā yòng jiāndìng de yǎnshén kàn zhe wǒ.
examples.english: He looked at me with a firm gaze.

examples.hanzi: 从她的眼神里，我知道她在说谎。
examples.pinyin: Cóng tā de yǎnshén lǐ, wǒ zhīdào tā zài shuōhuǎng.
examples.english: From the look in her eyes, I knew she was lying.

examples.hanzi: 他是个古怪的人，常常自言自语。
examples.pinyin: Tā shì ge gǔguài de rén, chángcháng zìyán zìyǔ.
examples.english: He is an eccentric person who often talks to himself.

examples.hanzi: 晚上，窗外传来一阵古怪的声音。
examples.pinyin: Wǎnshang, chuāngwài chuánlái yí zhèn gǔguài de shēngyīn.
examples.english: At night, a strange sound came from outside the window.

examples.hanzi: 这笔财产应该由两个孩子平分。
examples.pinyin: Zhè bǐ cáichǎn yīnggāi yóu liǎng ge háizi píngfēn.
examples.english: This property should be split equally between the two children.

examples.hanzi: 保护个人财产是每个人的权利。
examples.pinyin: Bǎohù gèrén cáichǎn shì měi ge rén de quánlì.
examples.english: Protecting personal property is everyone's right.

examples.hanzi: 我们的球队开始向对方进攻。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen de qiúduì kāishǐ xiàng duìfāng jìngōng.
examples.english: Our team started to attack the other side.

examples.hanzi: 进攻是最好的防守。
examples.pinyin: Jìngōng shì zuì hǎo de fángshǒu.
examples.english: Attack is the best defense.

examples.hanzi: 这个办法很简单，然而很有效。
examples.pinyin: Zhège bànfǎ hěn jiǎndān, rán'ér hěn yǒuxiào.
examples.english: This method is simple, yet very effective.

examples.hanzi: 我以为她会生气，然而她只是笑了笑。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yǐwéi tā huì shēngqì, rán'ér tā zhǐshì xiào le xiào.
examples.english: I thought she would be angry, but she just smiled.

examples.hanzi: 工作了一整天，你一定很辛苦吧？
examples.pinyin: Gōngzuò le yì zhěng tiān, nǐ yídìng hěn xīnkǔ ba?
examples.english: After working all day, you must be tired, right?

examples.hanzi: 为了养大三个孩子，妈妈吃了很多苦，很辛苦。
examples.pinyin: Wèile yǎng dà sān ge háizi, māma chī le hěn duō kǔ, hěn xīnkǔ.
examples.english: To raise three children, mom went through a lot and had a very hard time.

examples.hanzi: 他的游泳水平和专业运动员差不多。
examples.pinyin: Tā de yóuyǒng shuǐpíng hé zhuānyè yùndòngyuán chàbuduō.
examples.english: His swimming level is about the same as a professional athlete's.

examples.hanzi: 这个城市的生活水平越来越高。
examples.pinyin: Zhège chéngshì de shēnghuó shuǐpíng yuè lái yuè gāo.
examples.english: The standard of living in this city keeps rising.

examples.hanzi: 你剪了新发型，真好看！
examples.pinyin: Nǐ jiǎn le xīn fàxíng, zhēn hǎokàn!
examples.english: You got a new haircut. It looks great!

examples.hanzi: 这个发型很适合你的脸型。
examples.pinyin: Zhège fàxíng hěn shìhé nǐ de liǎnxíng.
examples.english: This hairstyle suits your face shape very well.

examples.hanzi: 他突然打断了我的话。
examples.pinyin: Tā tūrán dǎduàn le wǒ de huà.
examples.english: He suddenly cut off what I was saying.

examples.hanzi: 对不起，我可以打断一下吗？
examples.pinyin: Duìbuqǐ, wǒ kěyǐ dǎduàn yíxià ma?
examples.english: Sorry, may I interrupt for a moment?

examples.hanzi: 他受到了不公平的对待，想要报复。
examples.pinyin: Tā shòudào le bù gōngpíng de duìdài, xiǎng yào bàofù.
examples.english: He was treated unfairly and wanted revenge.

examples.hanzi: 报复别人只会让事情更糟。
examples.pinyin: Bàofù biéren zhǐ huì ràng shìqing gèng zāo.
examples.english: Retaliating against others will only make things worse.

examples.hanzi: 他们为了钱的事吵架了。
examples.pinyin: Tāmen wèile qián de shì chǎojià le.
examples.english: They had a quarrel over money.

examples.hanzi: 我不想和你吵架，我们好好谈谈吧。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ bù xiǎng hé nǐ chǎojià, wǒmen hǎohāo tántan ba.
examples.english: I don't want to argue with you; let's talk it through.

examples.hanzi: 我们一整天都在海边玩。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen yì zhěng tiān dōu zài hǎibiān wán.
examples.english: We played at the beach all day.

examples.hanzi: 下了一整天的雨，哪儿也不能去。
examples.pinyin: Xià le yì zhěng tiān de yǔ, nǎr yě bù néng qù.
examples.english: It rained the whole day, so we couldn't go anywhere.

examples.hanzi: 运动服装在三楼。
examples.pinyin: Yùndòng fúzhuāng zài sān lóu.
examples.english: The sportswear is on the third floor.

examples.hanzi: 表演的时候，大家都穿着民族服装。
examples.pinyin: Biǎoyǎn de shíhou, dàjiā dōu chuān zhe mínzú fúzhuāng.
examples.english: During the performance, everyone wore ethnic costumes.

examples.hanzi: 我做完作业了，可以出去玩吗？
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zuò wán zuòyè le, kěyǐ chūqù wán ma?
examples.english: I've finished my homework; may I go out to play?

examples.hanzi: 老师检查了我们的作业。
examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī jiǎnchá le wǒmen de zuòyè.
examples.english: The teacher checked our homework.

examples.hanzi: 这个手机的功能很高级。
examples.pinyin: Zhège shǒujī de gōngnéng hěn gāojí.
examples.english: This phone has very advanced features.

examples.hanzi: 他是公司的高级经理。
examples.pinyin: Tā shì gōngsī de gāojí jīnglǐ.
examples.english: He is a senior manager at the company.

examples.hanzi: 将来的世界会是什么样子？
examples.pinyin: Jiānglái de shìjiè huì shì shénme yàngzi?
examples.english: What will the world look like in the future?

examples.hanzi: 你将来想做什么工作？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ jiānglái xiǎng zuò shénme gōngzuò?
examples.english: What kind of job do you want to do in the future?

examples.hanzi: 学习外语需要很大的耐心。
examples.pinyin: Xuéxí wàiyǔ xūyào hěn dà de nàixīn.
examples.english: Learning a foreign language takes a lot of patience.

examples.hanzi: 请耐心等一下，医生马上就来。
examples.pinyin: Qǐng nàixīn děng yíxià, yīshēng mǎshàng jiù lái.
examples.english: Please wait patiently; the doctor will be here shortly.

examples.hanzi: 欧洲有很多历史悠久的城市。
examples.pinyin: Ōuzhōu yǒu hěn duō lìshǐ yōujiǔ de chéngshì.
examples.english: Europe has many cities with a long history.

examples.hanzi: 从欧洲飞到中国要十多个小时。
examples.pinyin: Cóng Ōuzhōu fēi dào Zhōngguó yào shí duō ge xiǎoshí.
examples.english: It takes more than ten hours to fly from Europe to China.

examples.hanzi: 做生意总是有风险的。
examples.pinyin: Zuò shēngyi zǒngshì yǒu fēngxiǎn de.
examples.english: Doing business always involves risk.

examples.hanzi: 这种药的风险很小，你不用担心。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng yào de fēngxiǎn hěn xiǎo, nǐ búyòng dānxīn.
examples.english: The risk of this medicine is very low, so don't worry.

examples.hanzi: 我们家新买了一个大沙发。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen jiā xīn mǎi le yí ge dà shāfā.
examples.english: We just bought a big new sofa for our home.

examples.hanzi: 朋友来我家时，可以睡在沙发上。
examples.pinyin: Péngyou lái wǒ jiā shí, kěyǐ shuì zài shāfā shang.
examples.english: When friends visit, they can sleep on the sofa.

examples.hanzi: 强奸是严重的犯罪，法律会严厉惩罚。
examples.pinyin: Qiángjiān shì yánzhòng de fànzuì, fǎlǜ huì yánlì chéngfá.
examples.english: Rape is a serious crime, and the law punishes it severely.

examples.hanzi: 警方正在调查一起强奸案。
examples.pinyin: Jǐngfāng zhèngzài diàochá yì qǐ qiángjiān àn.
examples.english: The police are investigating a rape case.

examples.hanzi: 你应该想一想这样做的后果。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ yīnggāi xiǎng yi xiǎng zhèyàng zuò de hòuguǒ.
examples.english: You should think about the consequences of doing this.

examples.hanzi: 不努力的后果是考试不及格。
examples.pinyin: Bù nǔlì de hòuguǒ shì kǎoshì bù jígé.
examples.english: The result of not working hard is failing the exam.

examples.hanzi: 这个故事太荒谬了，没人会相信。
examples.pinyin: Zhège gùshi tài huāngmiù le, méi rén huì xiāngxìn.
examples.english: This story is too ridiculous; nobody would believe it.

examples.hanzi: 他提出了一个荒谬的要求。
examples.pinyin: Tā tíchū le yí ge huāngmiù de yāoqiú.
examples.english: He made an absurd request.

examples.hanzi: 每个人的个性都不一样。
examples.pinyin: Měi ge rén de gèxìng dōu bù yíyàng.
examples.english: Everyone has a different personality.

examples.hanzi: 这件衣服很有个性，我很喜欢。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn yīfu hěn yǒu gèxìng, wǒ hěn xǐhuan.
examples.english: This piece of clothing has real character, and I like it a lot.

examples.hanzi: 天气不好，你最好别出门。
examples.pinyin: Tiānqì bù hǎo, nǐ zuìhǎo bié chū mén.
examples.english: The weather is bad, so you'd better not go out.

examples.hanzi: 这是我吃过的最好的蛋糕。
examples.pinyin: Zhè shì wǒ chī guo de zuì hǎo de dàngāo.
examples.english: This is the best cake I've ever eaten.

examples.hanzi: 男性和女性的平均寿命不同。
examples.pinyin: Nánxìng hé nǚxìng de píngjūn shòumìng bù tóng.
examples.english: The average life expectancy differs between men and women.

examples.hanzi: 这家健身房的会员大部分是男性。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā jiànshēnfáng de huìyuán dà bùfen shì nánxìng.
examples.english: Most members of this gym are men.

examples.hanzi: 我们正在收集大家的意见。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen zhèngzài shōují dàjiā de yìjiàn.
examples.english: We are collecting everyone's opinions.

examples.hanzi: 她喜欢收集漂亮的石头。
examples.pinyin: Tā xǐhuan shōují piàoliang de shítou.
examples.english: She likes collecting pretty stones.

examples.hanzi: 他和女朋友交往两年了。
examples.pinyin: Tā hé nǚ péngyou jiāowǎng liǎng nián le.
examples.english: He has been dating his girlfriend for two years.

examples.hanzi: 和不同的人交往能让你学到很多。
examples.pinyin: Hé bù tóng de rén jiāowǎng néng ràng nǐ xué dào hěn duō.
examples.english: Associating with different people lets you learn a lot.

examples.hanzi: 中尉带领士兵们回到了基地。
examples.pinyin: Zhōngwèi dàilǐng shìbīngmen huí dào le jīdì.
examples.english: The lieutenant led the soldiers back to the base.

examples.hanzi: 这位中尉已经服役五年了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè wèi zhōngwèi yǐjīng fúyì wǔ nián le.
examples.english: This lieutenant has served for five years.

examples.hanzi: 他在比赛中取得了第一名。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài bǐsài zhōng qǔdé le dì-yī míng.
examples.english: He won first place in the competition.

examples.hanzi: 你需要取得老师的同意才能进去。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ xūyào qǔdé lǎoshī de tóngyì cái néng jìnqù.
examples.english: You need to obtain the teacher's permission to go in.

examples.hanzi: 卡尔每天坐地铁去上班。
examples.pinyin: Kǎ'ěr měi tiān zuò dìtiě qù shàngbān.
examples.english: Karl takes the subway to work every day.

examples.hanzi: 我昨天遇到了卡尔，他问你好。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zuótiān yùdào le Kǎ'ěr, tā wèn nǐ hǎo.
examples.english: I ran into Karl yesterday, and he says hello.

examples.hanzi: 这种蛇的毒是致命的。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng shé de dú shì zhìmìng de.
examples.english: This snake's venom is deadly.

examples.hanzi: 一个小错误也可能带来致命的后果。
examples.pinyin: Yí ge xiǎo cuòwù yě kěnéng dàilái zhìmìng de hòuguǒ.
examples.english: Even a small mistake can have fatal consequences.

examples.hanzi: 月亮是地球唯一的天然卫星。
examples.pinyin: Yuèliang shì dìqiú wéiyī de tiānrán wèixīng.
examples.english: The moon is Earth's only natural satellite.

examples.hanzi: 很多手机导航都要依靠卫星。
examples.pinyin: Hěn duō shǒujī dǎoháng dōu yào yīkào wèixīng.
examples.english: Many phone navigation systems rely on satellites.

examples.hanzi: 老师对我们的期望很高。
examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī duì wǒmen de qīwàng hěn gāo.
examples.english: The teacher has high expectations of us.

examples.hanzi: 我期望明年能去国外读书。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ qīwàng míngnián néng qù guówài dú shū.
examples.english: I hope to study abroad next year.

examples.hanzi: 同学们都嘲笑他的新帽子。
examples.pinyin: Tóngxuémen dōu cháoxiào tā de xīn màozi.
examples.english: The classmates all laughed at his new hat.

examples.hanzi: 不要嘲笑别人的错误。
examples.pinyin: Bú yào cháoxiào biéren de cuòwù.
examples.english: Don't ridicule other people's mistakes.

examples.hanzi: 你一听到消息，就要立即告诉我。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ yì tīngdào xiāoxi, jiù yào lìjí gàosu wǒ.
examples.english: As soon as you hear the news, tell me immediately.

examples.hanzi: 发现火灾后，请立即拨打一一九。
examples.pinyin: Fāxiàn huǒzāi hòu, qǐng lìjí bōdǎ yāo-yāo-jiǔ.
examples.english: After you discover a fire, please dial 119 immediately.

examples.hanzi: 我们要避免在高峰期出门。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen yào bìmiǎn zài gāofēngqī chū mén.
examples.english: We should avoid going out during rush hour.

examples.hanzi: 这样做可以避免很多麻烦。
examples.pinyin: Zhèyàng zuò kěyǐ bìmiǎn hěn duō máfan.
examples.english: Doing it this way can avoid a lot of trouble.
